highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates to Skia m153 with font-fallback and GPU reliability corrections.
highlights_body: Linux fallback selection can choose a different face. This release also corrects cached-data destruction, glyph-atlas tracking and GPU-buffer failure handling.

breaking.title: Pin fonts when fallback selection must be deterministic
breaking.body: Linux fontconfig now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback. Applications relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; select an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 153 without managed API or C ABI changes. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

bullets.lead: More reliable GPU text and failure handling
bullets.detail: Prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from enabling stale location reuse and propagates render-task and submission failures. Checked buffer-upload failures reject affected draws instead of using stale contents, while triangulated paths retain CPU vertices for retry.
Corrects the BA2007 disabled-compiler-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll on x86, x64 and ARM64, avoiding that transitive-package gate failure without changing the native exports.
Releases the native cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding an unlock through freed memory.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Introduced Skia m153, the Linux fallback-font selection change and the cached-data mutex lifetime correction.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.

harfbuzz_summary: Corrects the Windows libHarfBuzzSharp BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error without changing its exported ABI. Package revision 14.2.1.300 still bundles native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, its Linux fallback-font selection change, and the cached-data mutex lifetime correction.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: The release candidate prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 finalizes glyph-atlas and GPU-buffer failure corrections.
v4.153.0.body: It also corrects the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
